name: print-social-wine-and-charm-tasting-posts-with-script-and-wine-stains
title: 'Wine & Charm' tasting pack with coral duotone photos, teal script words and wine-glass ring stains
whatItIs: Nine cream posts with coral duotone photos of wine glasses and tasters, large teal script words ('flavors', 'aromas', 'senses', 'best wines') overlapping images, coral ring stains like wine glass marks, thin uppercase teal copy and a small 'Wine & Charm' wordmark.
whatItMeans: Elegant and sensory; stains and flowing script evoke a real tasting table.
techniques: Add ring stains as authentic texture.
Let a big script word overlap photo and background.
Render photos as a single-colour duotone.
Pair script with small uppercase sans.

vocabulary.definition: A circular mark like a glass base.
An image rendered in two colours.
